item_short_desc: Rothco Tactical Pistol Lanyard is designed to attach a firearm to any tactical belt, metal clip or loop attachment. The overlapping hook & loop strap securely holds the tactical lanyard to any belt while the PVC coated coil stretches to 55" to allow for full arm extension while shooting. The Pistol Lanyard is ideal for law enforcement, security, military and airsoft players. Strap: Polyester , Hardware: Electrophoresed Iron & Aluminum , Coil: Outside Is PVC, Lanyard: Polypropylene , 3" Hook & Loop Belt Loop.
